title: 第七章 走火入魔第八章 叁瓜俩枣
content_zh:
听着身后疯婆子的尖叫，铁蛋都懒得回头看她一眼，就一声不吭沿着燕子峰的山道下攀，呼吸间工夫便下了燕子峰来到半山麓上，光霞山众弟子童子暂住的山舍中。
这会儿时间还早，太阳都没出来，屋舍里静悄悄的，其他童子都还在睡梦中。
也就是铁蛋习惯晚睡早起，蒹葭念叨着要给情郎报仇，俩人你追我赶，起了个大早，属于早起的虫儿被鸟吃了。
铁蛋就一个人到后院池塘，打了水擦洗脸上的血迹。抬头看看池塘中多出的人影。
“师兄。”
“怎么，她又来找你麻烦了。”
擦把脸的功夫，眯眯眼的周师兄现身出来，抛来一颗丹药。
“嗯。”
铁蛋接了，熟练得一掰两半，一半碾成粉末涂在伤口上止血，一半塞到嘴里含在舌下，就在池边坐下吸收药力。
周师兄眯着眼扫了他一眼，见没什么脏污，分明没认真动过手，随口出谋划策，
“你也不回她两剑？就算只杀伤了，也清静几天。”
铁蛋摇摇头，
“法宝。”
“呃，好吧……”
周师兄一听也懂了，就连侯府的丫鬟也有法宝护体，单靠一口剑炁破不开，杀不掉，一旦失手，反而失了逃生的机会。像铁蛋这样的穷光蛋，身上连个屁都没有的，去和人家一堆法宝的赌斗，一不小心就要身受重伤，连疗伤药都没有，自然一点都划不来。
这下周凤也没辙了，师父还欠了人家一条命，难道你一剑把她杀了？只能摇摇头随他俩去了。
这事儿旁人还真是挺难插手的，毕竟除了旧情的关联，北辰剑宗的规矩，向来是不禁弟子斗剑的，甚至还鼓励同门比斗。
真剑决死么，一来鞭策磨练弟子，不要荒废了修行，二来也可以去芜存菁，筛选掉酒囊饭袋，给宗门节省丹药法器筑基配给……
所以那沈蒹葭自拜入门来，就时时刻刻不忘为死在眼前的情郎报仇。
初时她还自知不是仇家敌手，不敢多过分，先刻苦修行不来找事。但这些天，仗着侯府那一马车的修炼资源，还有家教打下的基础，更兼得了陈真人所传剑宗秘法后，她现在反倒是抢先一步，筑基成功了。

这下她可就来了劲了，三天两头往燕子峰跑，在师兄面前不敢动手，就专门在山头埋伏，等着铁蛋炼炁落单的时候伏击暗杀。
那毕竟，人家本来就小女子一个么，又不是什么大丈夫，犯不着和你正大光明的比武。何况就算正大光明的斗剑邀约，铁蛋也不会傻乎乎接下来就是了。
不过铁蛋倒也无所谓。
其实他打小见的生死也多了去了，连抢块肉都要被狗咬，莫名其妙就挨一顿毒打，生死边缘好多回了，实不差多一两个莫名其妙的疯子想要他命的。
而且，他其实也偷偷摸摸的，礼尚往来，试过反杀的。
嗯，铁蛋其实也眼红这些有钱人，揣度着若是能把那疯婆子杀了，夺了那侯爷一车的宝物，莫说筑基，连以后修炼到金丹境界的资材用度，都不缺了吧。
所以铁蛋也趁着那蒹葭修炼沐浴，入睡调息，轻敌无备之时，口喷剑炁刺杀过两次，只可惜没有成功。
毕竟若只是一件法宝，他或许还可以拼上一拼，但铁蛋试探下来，发现对方身上，除了那死侯爷一口削铁如泥的宝剑，竟至少还有三件法宝！
腰间有一枚金铃铛，潜伏太近，或盯得太久，便会察觉敌意，自动响铃示警。
腕上有一枚金镯，会在身前生出炁盾，大幅削弱神罡剑炁的剑力，以铁蛋现在的剑力，只能炁盾的边角处突过去，很难正面击碎。
另外这疯婆子还贴身穿着一件灵丝肚兜，上箓符法，连沐浴时也不离身，用来守身护体，辟邪除秽，还能散发灵息，加快伤口愈合。
虽然铁蛋也借着那颗人头里挖来的内丹滋补，打通神罡剑脉，炼成周天炁体循环，但现在卡在筑基的关口上不能突破，也只能反复熬炼一口剑炁罢了。
只有一口炁，本门的上乘剑诀一样都使不出，口喷的剑炁到底射程有限，他又得避免被金铃发觉，不能仔细盯着对方的破绽出招，因此即使强破了金镯护盾，也难以刺穿那件护体的肚兜，实在难以下手。
而被铁蛋偷袭了几次后，现在蒹葭也警惕起来了，这疯婆子也狡猾得很，借口男女有别，和陈胡子提了几次，于是考虑到照顾女眷，陈胡子便把山下枫叶林里的宅子让给蒹葭居住，还给她布置了阵法守护，搞得铁蛋也没法夜袭了。
再加上这疯婆子日常上山听讲，也做足了防备，平日更躲在那辆藏了不知多少宝贝的马车里休息，车里还贴了好多符箓，车轮都是钢筋，厢车暗藏铁板，车里还有弓弩机关，随时射出暗镖毒箭，更不好近前，已经很难抓到刺杀的机会了。
难了。
content_en:
Listening to the scream of the crazy woman behind him, Tiedan didn't even bother to look back at her, so he climbed down the Yanzi Peak mountain path without saying a word. In just a breath, he descended from Yanzi Peak to the mountain house where the disciples and boys of Guangxia Mountain were staying at the foot of the mountain.
It was still early at this time, the sun had not yet come out, the house was quiet, and the other children were still asleep.
That is to say, Tiedan was accustomed to going to bed late and getting up early, and Jianjia was talking about revenge for her lover. The two of them chased each other and woke up very early. Their morning bug was eaten by the bird.
Tiedan went to the pond in the backyard alone, fetched water and wiped the blood off his face. Look up at the extra figures in the pond.
"Senior brother."
"Why, she's coming to trouble you again."
While wiping his face, Senior Brother Zhou appeared with narrowed eyes and threw a pill.
"Yeah."
Tie Dan took it, broke it in half with skill, crushed half into powder and applied it on the wound to stop the bleeding, put the other half into his mouth and held it under his tongue, then sat down by the pool to absorb the medicine.
Senior Brother Zhou glanced at him with squinted eyes and saw that there was no dirt on him. He clearly didn't take any serious action and just gave him some advice casually.
"You won't return her two swords? Even if you only kill and wound her, you will be quiet for a few days."
Tiedan shook his head,
"Magic weapon."
"Uh, okay..."
Senior Brother Zhou understood as soon as he heard it. Even the maids of the Hou Mansion were protected by magic weapons. They could not be broken or killed by a sword alone. Once they missed, they would lose the chance to escape. A pauper like Tiedan, who doesn't even have a shit on his body, goes to have a gambling fight with a bunch of magic weapons. If he is not careful, he will be seriously injured. He doesn't even have any healing medicine, so naturally it doesn't pay off at all.
Zhou Feng has no choice now. Master still owes her a life. Could it be that you killed her with one sword? I could only shake my head and let them go.
It is really difficult for others to get involved in this matter. After all, apart from the old relationship, Beichen Sword Sect's rules have always prohibited its disciples from fighting swords, and even encouraged fellow disciples to compete.
The real sword fights to the death. Firstly, it encourages and trains the disciples, so as not to waste their practice. Secondly, it can also eliminate the waste and keep the good, filter out the wine bags and rice bags, and save the sect's elixirs, magic tools, and foundation-building rations...
Therefore, Shen Jianjia has never forgotten to avenge her lover who died in front of her eyes.
At the beginning, she knew she was not an enemy, so she didn't dare to go too far. She practiced hard first and didn't cause trouble. But these days, relying on the training resources of the Hou Mansion, the foundation laid by her tutor, and the secret method of the Sword Sect taught by Chen Zhenren, she is now taking the lead and successfully building the foundation.
Now she became more energetic and ran to Yanzi Peak every two days. She didn't dare to make a move in front of her senior brother, so she lurked at the top of the mountain, waiting for the iron egg to be refined and left alone to ambush and assassinate him.
After all, I am just a little girl, and I am not a man. I can't compete with you in an honest and fair way. What's more, even if it was an honest invitation to a sword fight, Tiedan wouldn't be stupid and follow it up.
But it doesn't matter if it's an iron egg.
In fact, he had been on the verge of life and death many times. He was bitten by a dog even when he tried to grab a piece of meat, and was beaten severely for no apparent reason. He was on the verge of life and death many times. There were probably one or two inexplicable lunatics who wanted to kill him.
Moreover, he was actually sneaky, reciprocated with courtesy, and tried to fight back.
Well, Tiedan is actually jealous of these rich people, and he thinks that if he can kill the crazy woman and seize the Marquis's cart full of treasures, not to mention foundation building, he will even be able to cultivate to the golden elixir realm in the future.
So Tiedan also took advantage of Jian Jia's practice, bathing, sleeping and adjusting her breath, and when she underestimated her enemy, she breathed sword Qi and assassinated him twice, but unfortunately she was unsuccessful.
After all, if it was just a magic weapon, he might be able to give it a try, but Tiedan tested it out and found that in addition to the dead prince's sword, which was as sharp as clay, there were at least three magic weapons on his body!
There is a golden bell around his waist. If he lurks too close or stares for too long, he will detect hostility and automaticallyRing the warning bell.
There is a gold bracelet on the wrist, which will generate Qi shield in front of the body, greatly weakening the sword power of Shengang Sword Qi. With Tiedan's current sword power, it can only break through the corners of Qi shield, and it is difficult to crush it head-on.
In addition, this crazy woman also wears a spiritual silk bellyband with talismans on it, which she keeps with her even when bathing. It is used to protect her body, ward off evil spirits and eliminate dirt, and it can also emit spiritual energy and speed up wound healing.
Although Tiedan also nourished himself with the inner elixir dug out of the human head, opened up the Shengang sword veins, and refined the circulation of Zhou Tianqi body, but now he is stuck at the foundation-building barrier and cannot break through, and he can only refine one sword qi repeatedly.
With only one Qi, he couldn't use any of the best sword techniques in his sect. The range of the sword Qi sprayed by his mouth was limited, and he had to avoid being noticed by Jin Ling, so he couldn't carefully watch the opponent's weaknesses to make moves. Therefore, even if he broke through the golden bracelet shield, it would be difficult to pierce the body-protecting bellyband. It was really difficult to attack.
After being attacked several times by Tie Dan, Jian Jia was now on guard. This crazy woman was also very cunning. She mentioned it to Chen Huzi several times on the pretext of the difference between men and women. So out of consideration for taking care of his female family members, Chen Huzi gave Jian Jia the house in the maple leaf forest at the foot of the mountain to live in. He also arranged a formation to protect her, so that Tie Dan could not attack at night.
In addition, this crazy woman went up the mountain to listen to lectures every day, so she was well prepared. She even hid in the carriage with countless treasures hidden in it to rest. There were also many talismans attached to the carriage, the wheels were made of steel bars, the carriage had hidden iron plates, and there was also a crossbow mechanism in the carriage, which could shoot out hidden darts and poisonous arrows at any time. Not to mention, it was difficult to get close enough to seize the opportunity to assassinate her.
Difficult.
